```
data/
├── raw/           ai4i2020.csv          ← the ONE external dataset (real, CC BY 4.0)
```

| `raw/ai4i2020.csv` | 10,000 | **Real** — UCI AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance (synthetic *in origin*, but a fixed published dataset used as-is; sha256 `dc6630cd…c8a8e`, verified by `scripts/download_ai4i.py`) |
| `generated/machines.csv` | 24 | Synthetic (this repo) |

| `generated/manifest.json` | — | Provenance: seed, as-of, per-file sha256, CNC-03 scenario summary |

**Everything in `generated/` is fictional factory data created for this hackathon prototype.**
No real plant, machine, supplier, person or event is depicted. The CNC-03 degradation story is
scripted (below), not an observed failure.

---

## Reproduce

```bash
python3.11 scripts/download_ai4i.py            # fetch + verify data/raw/ai4i2020.csv (or --check offline)
python3.11 scripts/generate_factory_data.py    # generate + validate data/generated/
python3.11 scripts/generate_factory_data.py --verify   # prove determinism: re-run must be byte-identical
```

- Determinism: master seed `20261003`, one SHA-256-derived RNG per domain, fixed `AS_OF`
  (`2026-10-03T00:00:00`). The scripts never read the wall clock → same output today and next year.
- Both scripts are stdlib-only (no pandas needed to build the data).
- Validation is built in: every re-run checks row-count windows (playbook data plan), machine/part
  referential integrity, part↔machine compatibility, work-order ↔ history pairing, downtime ↔
  production-runs reconciliation, and the CNC-03 scenario asserts.
- AI4I licence: **CC BY 4.0** — citation: *AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset [Dataset]. (2020).
  UCI Machine Learning Repository.* https://doi.org/10.24432/C5HS5C

---

## `raw/ai4i2020.csv` — UCI AI4I 2020 (the F3 baseline-model input)

10,000 data points from a synthetic milling process, 14 columns:

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|--------|------|---------|
| `UDI` | int | Unique identifier 1–10,000 (spelled `UDI` in the file; the UCI page says `UID` — the file wins) |
| `Product ID` | text | Quality variant letter (L/M/H) + serial number |
| `Type` | text | L = low (~50%), M = medium (~30%), H = high (~20%) quality variant |
| `Air temperature [K]` | float | Ambient, random walk ~300 K (σ = 2 K) |
| `Process temperature [K]` | float | Air temp + 10 K + random walk (σ = 1 K) |
| `Rotational speed [rpm]` | int | From a 2860 W process power + normal noise |
| `Torque [Nm]` | float | Normal ~40 Nm, σ = 10 Nm, no negatives |
| `Tool wear [min]` | int | Cumulative tool wear; variant adds H 5 / M 3 / L 2 min |
| `Machine failure` | 0/1 | Target: 1 if any failure mode fired |
| `TWF` | 0/1 | Tool wear failure (wear 200–240 min) |
| `HDF` | 0/1 | Heat dissipation failure (temp diff < 8.6 K and speed < 1380 rpm) |
| `PWF` | 0/1 | Power failure (torque × speed outside 3.5–9 kW) |
| `OSF` | 0/1 | Overstrain failure (wear × torque > 11,000/12,000/13,000 minNm for L/M/H) |
| `RNF` | 0/1 | Random failure (0.1% chance) |

Used **only** by the F3 model (`ml/train.py`); the app never serves AI4I rows as factory telemetry.

## `generated/` tables

Conventions: ids are stable text codes (`CNC-03`, `BRG-AX-17`, `WO-0096`); timestamps are ISO
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` **UTC-naive local plant time**; empty string = not applicable (documented per
column below). The "as of" snapshot instant is 2026-10-03T00:00:00; telemetry covers the previous
16 days; production runs the previous 14 days.

### `machines.csv` — asset registry + twin placement (24 machines)

| Column | Synthetic? | Meaning |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| `machine_id` | synthetic | Stable id `CNC-01…08`, `PRS-01…04`, `ASM-01…05`, `PKG-01…04`, `QLT-01…03` |
| `name` | synthetic | Human label |
| `line` | synthetic | `CNC_LINE` / `PRESS_LINE` / `ASSEMBLY_LINE` / `PACKAGING_LINE` / `QUALITY_LINE` |
| `type` | synthetic | `CNC` / `PRESS` / `ASSEMBLY` / `PACKAGING` / `QUALITY` (drives telemetry baselines) |
| `manufacturer`, `model` | fictional but realistic | e.g. DMG MORI DMU 50, Fanuc M-20iD |
| `installed_year` | synthetic | 2016–2022 |
| `status` | scripted | Snapshot state: 20×`HEALTHY`, `WARNING`=CNC-06, `CRITICAL`=CNC-03, `MAINTENANCE`=PRS-03, `OFFLINE`=PKG-04. Same vocabulary as the twin/UI |
| `health_score` | heuristic (documented) | 0–100 = 100 minus penalties for vibration/temperature deviation from the type baseline. Empty **only** for OFFLINE (PKG-04, not scored) |
| `x_m`, `y_m`, `z_m` | synthetic | Twin coordinates in metres. z = 0.0 for all (single floor). Layout: assembly row y≈2, CNC row y=18, press row y=34, packaging row y=50, quality row y=66 |

### `sensor_readings.csv` — telemetry (11,136 rows, 2026-09-17 → 2026-10-03)

Hourly per machine; **CNC-03 at 10-minute cadence** (its demo series).

| Column | Synthetic? | Meaning |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| `reading_id` | synthetic | `SR-000001…`, unique, ordered by machine then timestamp |
| `machine_id` | FK → machines | |
| `ts` | synthetic | Reading timestamp |
| `vibration_rms_mm_s` | simulated | RMS velocity at the bearing housing; type baseline + noise (+ scripted CNC-03 ramp, + mild CNC-06 drift) |
| `bearing_temp_c` | simulated | °C; baseline + diurnal (±0.9) + noise (+ scripted ramp) |
| `spindle_speed_rpm` | simulated | Type baseline ±1.5%; zeroed for OFFLINE PKG-04 after 2026-10-01 |
| `motor_current_a` | simulated | Baseline ±4% (+ rises with the CNC-03 ramp) |
| `coolant_pressure_bar` | simulated | CNC/press only (0 for other types); falls slightly on the CNC-03 ramp |
| `cycle_time_s` | simulated | Type baseline ±2% |

### `production_runs.csv` — OEE inputs (336 rows = 24 machines × 14 days, 2026-09-19 → 2026-10-03)

| Column | Synthetic? | Meaning |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| `run_id` | synthetic | `PR-0001…` |
| `machine_id` | FK → machines | |
| `run_date` | synthetic | One row per machine-day |
| `planned_output_units` | derived | planned_runtime × 3600 ÷ ideal_cycle |
| `actual_output_units` | simulated | runtime × 3600 ÷ ideal × performance (0.86–0.97) |
| `good_units` | simulated | actual × (1 − scrap); CNC-03 scrap rises the last 3 days (bearing chatter) |
| `ideal_cycle_time_s` | baseline | Type constant (CNC 118 s, press 6.5 s, …) |
| `runtime_minutes` | derived | planned_runtime − downtime_minutes |
| `planned_runtime_minutes` | synthetic | GCC shift pattern: Mon–Thu 480, Fri 240, Sat/Sun 480; minus the planned PM window; PKG-04 rows after 2026-10-01 are 0 (offline, out of planned production time) |
| `downtime_minutes` | reconciled | = sum of that machine-day's unplanned `downtime_events` |

### `downtime_events.csv` — 54 rows (within the production window, except two scripted rows)

| Column | Synthetic? | Meaning |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| `event_id` | synthetic | `DT-001…` |
| `machine_id` | FK → machines | |
| `start_ts`, `end_ts` | synthetic | `end_ts` empty = **ongoing at as-of** (the PKG-04 outage) |
| `duration_minutes` | synthetic | Capped inside the shift for closed events |
| `cause_category` | synthetic | `mechanical_failure`, `electrical_failure`, `changeover`, `material_shortage`, `operator_error`, `unknown`, `planned_maintenance` |
| `description` | synthetic | |
| `production_impact_units` | derived | duration × 3600 ÷ ideal_cycle |

Unplanned rows (excluding `planned_maintenance` and the open event) sum exactly to the machine-day
`downtime_minutes` in production_runs. Earlier (pre-window) downtime lives only in maintenance_history.

## The scripted CNC-03 bearing-degradation scenario

The demo story is **generated, not random** — these invariants are asserted on every run:

| Element | Value |
|---------|-------|
| Machine | `CNC-03` (Haas VF-4SS, CNC line, twin position 24, 18, 0) |
| Window | 14 days of 10-minute telemetry ending 2026-10-03T00:00 |
| Ramp | Starts `AS_OF − 5 days` (2026-09-28), reaches full at `AS_OF` (120 h, eased curve) |
| Vibration | 2.4 → ~5.4 mm/s RMS (first-24h mean 2.39 → last-24h mean 5.0) — ISO 10816 zone A/B → zone C |
| Bearing temp | 62 → ~71.5 °C (means 62.0 → 70.7) — crosses the 65 °C warning / 72 °C critical thresholds in the knowledge corpus |
| Ancillary | motor current +2.2 A, coolant pressure −0.6 bar over the ramp |
| Snapshot status | `CRITICAL`, health_score 42 |
| History evidence | two prior `bearing_wear` repairs, both used `BRG-AX-17` |
| Part | `BRG-AX-17` stock 2 ≤ reorder 3 (limited) |
| Action | exactly one `proposed` CNC-03 work order citing `BRG-AX-17`, window Sun 2026-10-04 07:00 |

Demo Mode (F10) replays this arc locally; Snowflake C2 sanity-checks the same values after load.
